title: Alzheimer_detection
summary: A gait-analysis pipeline for building lightweight Alzheimer's classification models from biomechanical patient data. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality to augment a 102-subject dataset into thousands of statistically validated synthetic rows for training.
evidence: data_augmentor/ctgan_augmentor.py: 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' and 'ctgan_synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=500, ...)'
